documentation.DL_LEN: Length of delay line in samples; also determines the latency.
documentation.COMPR_RAT: Compression multiplier after crossing the threshold
documentation.WOW_FREQ_HZ: Speed modifier triangle oscillator frequency in Hz
documentation.GAIN_MULT: Gain multiplier that multiplies the Depth parameter on top of unity gain.
documentation.GAIN_COMP_RANGE_MIN: Compensation min in 1 / ( min + delta * depth )
documentation.GAIN_COMP_RANGE_DELTA: Compensation min in 1 / ( min + delta * depth )
documentation.HISS_MIN: Hiss gain min in (min + delta * depth)
documentation.HISS_DELTA: Hiss gain delta in (min + delta * depth)
documentation.HUM_MIN: Hum gain min in (min + delta^2 * depth)
documentation.HUM_DELTA: Hum gain delta in (min + delta^2 * depth)
documentation.FLT_CUT_MAX: Filter cut max frequency in Hz in (max - delta * depth)
documentation.FLT_CUT_DELTA: Filter cut delta frequency in Hz in (max - delta * depth)
documentation.FLT_CUT_MOD_MIN: Filter ducking based on amplitude max frequency in Hz in (max - delta * log(depth))
documentation.FLT_CUT_MOD_DELTA: Filter ducking based on amplitude delta frequency in Hz in (max - delta * log(depth))
documentation.SPEED_DISTURBANCE_MIN: Speed disturbance amount min in (min + delta * time)
documentation.SPEED_DISTURBANCE_DELTA: Speed disturbance amount delta in (min + delta * time)
documentation.SPEED_DISTURBANCE_PROB_MIN: Speed disturbance probability per sample (out of 1024) min (min + delta * time)
documentation.SPEED_DISTURBANCE_PROB_DELTA: Speed disturbance probability per sample (out of 1024) min (min + delta * time)
documentation.SPEED_KP_MIN: Speed PI controller P gain min in (min + delta * time)
documentation.SPEED_KP_DELTA: Speed PI controller P gain delta in (min + delta * time)
